The elements of the given set are the negative real numbers that satisfy the inequality $3{x}^{2}\le 27.$ 

So, we first need to solve our inequality for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2} & \le 27 \\ {x}^{2} & \le 9 \\ \sqrt{{x}^{2}} & \le \sqrt{9} \\ |x| & \le 3 \\ -3\le x & \le 3\end{aligned}
$$

The negative real numbers that are solutions to the inequality above are $x\in [-3,0).$ Therefore, the given set can be written as 

$$
A=[-3,0).
$$
